summary: PASS — Verified ClauseClock Stage 2 renewal_notice UI behavior. critical_code_review_comments: FindingCard.jsx noticeText() correctly builds the min–max window when notice_days_max is present; the date-based Notice window Fact is properly gated by (!needsReview && e.earliest_action_date), preventing 'Invalid Date' on needs_review findings.

Minor: on the DealMaker page, notice-window Fact was absent even though this is a validated finding — check whether earliest_action_date is populated server-side; if intended to render for validated findings with both dates, verify the DealMaker record has earliest_action_date set. (Not a regression; card still shows hero date and 60 days notice.)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing Punakaiki and DealMaker contracts already analyzed in prior runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: cookies are httpOnly + Secure; use expect_navigation() around submit-click. After login, navigate directly to /app/contracts to see the list.
